regions.description: Type bit 7 set goes to the per-frame code (`$A46E`). Table stats: collision flags `$50` (Eraser-immune, big burst), hit points 6 (replaced), attack 32, drawing flags 0, art block `$1A`, dies as type 8. Strength comes from the AREA TIER (`$9B0F`), as for types `$0E` / `$0F`, and the attack is not scaled.
